run_retrieval_pytorch: run brute-force inner-product search using PyTorch on query and corpus embeddings with shard support
run_retrieval_trec_format: run retrieval with TREC format query input and output for TREC evaluation
run_retrieval_sharded: run retrieval on a large index divided into multiple shards and merge results
run_retrieval_ignore_identical: run retrieval on BEIR datasets while ignoring identical query and document IDs
run_retrieval_custom_topk: run retrieval with a custom top-k value and batch size for GPU search
